newsitem.title: MEXICO: Alestra says has 410,00 Mexico City phone ballots.
newsitem.headline: Alestra says has 410,00 Mexico City phone ballots.

text.p: Telecommunications company Alestra said on Monday that it has received 410,000 ballots for long distance service in Mexico City.

Alestra said in a statement 410,000 ballots returned were in its favor, out of a total 1.6 million slips returned by homes and businesses in the area. Alestra said 2.644 million slips had been delivered.
Mexico's long-distance telephone market opened to competition on January 1, after former state-owned company Telefonos de Mexico (Telmex) had held a monopoly for decades.
Homes or businesses not returning slips will be taken as opting to remain with Telmex.
Alestra is a joint venture between conglomerate Alfa, financial firm Visa-Bancomer and U.S. based AT&T Corp.
